items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nat said, “We can’t do – how are we going to do this?” I said, “I’ll talk to them if you want me to.”

ctx.x: Were you at Pep’s in Philly?

Pep’s, yeah. Nat said, “We can’t do – how are we going to do this?” I said, “I’ll talk to them if you want me to.” I said, “I’ll do that.” I said, “We’ll pay them.” I said, “I’ll pay them for the week, and we’ll send them home. We’ll hire [?]. We’ll go into rehearsals tomorrow.” We hired – I don’t remember off the top of my head exactly the musicians, but I think if you can recall who they were . . .
